comment: The public-API freeze (DESIGN.md §12): per module, the top-level declarations scripts/check-api.sh holds to the baseline in api/. "*" freezes the whole module; "Outer.Inner" freezes only Inner. The placeholder modules (AetherDecide, Aether) declare nothing of their own (Aether only re-exports the task modules) and join when they have API (M5-M6). "enforce": true since the 0.1.0 freeze: a breaking change or a stale baseline fails CI.
